quote: We use the P-SP metric to assess the semantic similarity of paraphrases, ... we assess the quality of produced text by calculating the perplexity (PPL) using LLaMA-13B.

We use the P-SP metric to assess the semantic similarity of paraphrases, past work considers the semantics of the paraphrase to be preserved if the P-SP value exceeds 0.76. Additionally, we assess the quality of produced text by calculating the perplexity (PPL) using LLaMA-13B, which we consider as an oracle model.
